key_points: Oracle director purchased $3.5M of shares, signaling insider confidence.
Google's Gemini AI model added to Oracle's AI lineup, strengthening cloud/AI position.
Oracle announced a $10 million contribution to the Nashville Symphony, enhancing ESG profile.
Rumors of December layoffs and insider trading alerts introduce some downside risk.
Institutional sellers (Rockland Trust, Eastern Bank) trimmed modest positions, reflecting mixed sentiment.
